# Pratham Purohit

> Full-Stack Developer based in India, specializing in React, Three.js, Node.js, TypeScript, and WebGL. Builds real-time web apps, interactive 3D browser experiences, and multiplayer games. This site is an interactive 3D portfolio.

Currently a UI/UX Developer (training) at Genesis Technologies, Indore. Previously a Junior Web Developer at Inviolate Technologies LLP. Holds a BTech in Computer Science & Engineering from Shoolini University of Biotechnology and Management Sciences (2021–2025). Open to full-time roles and freelance work — see the Talk section.

## Projects

- Baba Is You (Feb 2026) — Canvas-based puzzle simulation engine. JavaScript, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL, deployed on Neon/Railway. https://github.com/plutocrate/iluvbaba
- GTutor (Jan 2026) — Real-time gesture-based guitar tutor using MediaPipe gesture recognition and Web Audio API. React, TypeScript.
- MrPhony (Mar 2026) — ASCII terrain strategy game converting real-world topography into game maps with Claude AI assistance. React, TypeScript, GitHub Actions. https://github.com/plutocrate/mrphony
- Beat Dancer (Mar 2026) — Browser-based rhythm game with Three.js/WebGL and Mixamo 3D character animation synced to music. https://beatonline-production.up.railway.app/
- Gwent Multiplayer (Feb 2026) — Real-time multiplayer card game (Witcher 3 inspired) with room-based 1v1 matches. Node.js, Express, Socket.IO. https://gwent-mult-production.up.railway.app/

## Skills

JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Three.js/WebGL, HTML5/CSS3/Tailwind CSS, Node.js/Express, GSAP, PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB, Socket.io, Canvas API, REST APIs, Linux/Nginx, GitHub Actions.
